summary_en: This phase 1 study tests a personalized dose of melphalan given before a stem cell transplant in people with multiple myeloma. Patients receive high-dose melphalan IV over 30 minutes on day -3, then a second melphalan IV dose over 30 minutes on day -1 that is set using blood level (pharmacokinetic) analysis, followed by stem cell infusion on day 0. The study looks at the best dose and the side effects of melphalan.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba una dosis personalizada de melfalán administrada antes de un trasplante de células madre en personas con mieloma múltiple. Los pacientes reciben melfalán IV en dosis alta durante 30 minutos el día -3, luego una segunda dosis IV de melfalán durante 30 minutos el día -1, ajustada según el análisis de los niveles de melfalán en sangre (farmacocinética), y después la infusión de células madre el día 0. El estudio busca determinar la mejor dosis y los efectos secundarios del melfalán.
who_for: Clinical diagnosis of a plasma cell neoplasm that needs treatment, per the treating physician
Phase A: at least 2 prior lines of therapy and estimated kidney filtration (eGFR by Cockcroft-Gault) above 40 mL/min
Phase B: transplant must be part of first-line therapy
Absolute neutrophil count at least 1000/uL and platelets at least 100,000
ECOG performance status 2 or less (Karnofsky 60% or higher); able to understand and sign informed consent
not_for: Progressive disease or clinical relapse before the planned melphalan infusion on day -3
Serious heart problems, such as NYHA class III or IV heart failure, heart attack within 6 months, or QTc above 480 msec
HIV positive, with limited exceptions; hepatitis B surface antigen positive; or hepatitis C without sustained virologic response
POEMS syndrome, AL amyloidosis, or Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia
